headline: Fitch assigns expected AAA ratings to Citigroup residential mortgage trust
summary: Fitch Ratings assigned expected 'AAAsf' ratings to five senior tranche classes of Citigroup Mortgage Loan Trust 2026-SHE1, with an 18.4% AAA stress loss assumption.
why: Citigroup Inc. is a leading US global investment bank issuing residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS).

impacts.name: Citigroup Inc.
impacts.why: Top-tier credit ratings validate structured residential mortgage security originations.
